name: Jukuren Ganbou ~Himeta Omoi to Midara na Ai no Katachi~
original_name: 熟恋願望 秘めた想いと淫らな愛のカタチ
source: Sakashita Shingo is a new teacher. Dealing with 3 moms on committee and there children who usually involved. With the help of of a senior teacher he does his best to be a teacher for moms and kids.
translation: 坂下真吾是一名新任教师。他需要与委员会中的三位母亲打交道，她们的孩子也经常牵涉其中。在一位资深教师的帮助下，他努力成为能够照顾母亲和孩子们的好老师。
